captions.detailed: A small-office, all-in-one printer in a light gray finish. It features a tall main body housing a hollow paper output tray path, a sliding lower paper cassette, and a side service door. On top sits a scanner flatbed with a hinged lid, which supports a dark gray automatic document feeder (ADF) with its own top-hinged lid. A dark gray control panel on the front contains a central rectangular touchscreen, four separate pushable hard keys below it, and a rotating selector dial on its right side.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a tall all-in-one office printer using CadQuery. The design must feature a main body with an integrated hollow paper tray path, a sliding lower paper cassette, a hinged flatbed scanner lid with an automatic document feeder (ADF) on top, and a front control panel. The control panel should tilt on a horizontal pivot and include a rotating selector dial alongside four separate pushable hard keys.
captions.factory: Construct the printer using a main body box with subtracted hollows for the paper path and cassette slot. Create the paper cassette as a separate box that slides prismatically along the Y-axis. Model the scanner lid and ADF unit as stacked boxes, adding revolute joints at their respective rear hinges. Build the control panel as a box with a recessed screen, attaching it via a revolute joint to the front body. Finally, construct the selector dial as a cylinder with a continuous rotation joint, and the four hard keys as small boxes with prismatic joints.
